articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Vision, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring significantly improved chain-of-thought reasoning that operates natively across text, image, audio, and code modalities simultaneously. Benchmarks show a 38% improvement on SWE-bench and near-human performance on graduate-level scientific reasoning tasks. The model also introduces a persistent memory architecture that maintains coherent context across sessions without explicit retrieval augmentation.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics Foundation Model Enables Zero-Shot Manipulation in Unstructured Environments
articles.summary: DeepMind published results from its Gemini Robotics foundation model, demonstrating that a single vision-language-action model can perform complex manipulation tasks in novel environments without task-specific fine-tuning. The system was tested across 14 different robot embodiments and achieved an 87% success rate on previously unseen household tasks. This represents a major step toward general-purpose robotic intelligence that transfers across hardware platforms.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm GAA Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced that its N1.4 process node using gate-all-around (GAA) transistor architecture has entered volume production, roughly two months ahead of the original timeline. The node delivers a 20% performance uplift and 30% power reduction compared to N2, targeting AI accelerator and high-performance computing workloads. Major customers including NVIDIA and Apple are expected to tape out designs within the first quarter of 2027.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional Classifiers v2 to Defend Against Jailbreak and Prompt Injection Attacks
articles.summary: Anthropic published a technical report on Constitutional Classifiers v2, a layered defense system that reduces successful jailbreak rates to under 0.2% on adversarial benchmarks while maintaining low refusal rates on benign queries. The system uses a novel approach of training lightweight classifier heads on constitutionally generated attack-and-defense pairs. The technique is model-agnostic and Anthropic is releasing the training framework as open source to improve ecosystem-wide safety.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Commercial Atlas Fleet for Automotive Manufacturing Lines
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics officially launched the commercial deployment of its electric Atlas humanoid robot fleet in three Hyundai-Kia automotive plants in South Korea. The robots handle heavy part transfer, quality inspection via onboard vision, and adaptive assembly tasks alongside human workers. Each unit operates autonomously for 8-hour shifts with a reported 99.1% uptime, marking the most significant real-world humanoid deployment in manufacturing to date.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Scout and Maverick Models with 10M Token Context and MoE Architecture
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4 Scout (17B active parameters, 109B total) and Maverick (17B active/128B total) under a permissive license, both leveraging mixture-of-experts with native support for up to 10 million token context windows. Scout achieves competitive performance with GPT-4o on major benchmarks while being deployable on a single H100 node. The release includes optimized inference code for vLLM and TensorRT-LLM, significantly lowering the cost of long-context enterprise deployments.

articles.title: Breakthrough Solid-State Battery from QuantumScape Achieves 600 Wh/kg in Independently Verified Tests
articles.summary: QuantumScape reported independently verified results for its latest solid-state lithium-metal cell achieving 600 Wh/kg gravimetric energy density with over 1,000 cycle durability at 80% capacity retention. This nearly doubles the energy density of current state-of-the-art lithium-ion cells used in EVs and drones. The company announced a partnership with Volkswagen to begin pilot production in early 2027, potentially transforming range economics for electric vehicles and eVTOL aircraft.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins with First Compliance Audits Targeting Foundation Model Providers
articles.summary: The European Commission initiated its first formal compliance audits under the EU AI Act, targeting six major foundation model providers including OpenAI, Google, and Meta to assess systemic risk evaluations, red-teaming documentation, and energy consumption reporting. Companies face fines of up to 7% of global annual revenue for non-compliance with general-purpose AI model obligations. The enforcement actions are being closely watched as a precedent that could shape global AI governance frameworks.
